# Life Ledger · Deep Review 2.0.10 · Mac 3.0.4

## Fixed

- **Habit accent colour**: choosing a colour in the habit settings stuck to the first colour in Safari and the Mac app. It now keeps the colour you pick (also in the **New habit** dialog).
- **Icon picker**: the icon panel was see-through and the form underneath showed through it and caught clicks. It is now solid and on top.

## Mac app

If you have 3.0.2 or newer, the app offers this update itself (**Update and Restart**).

## Roll back

Tag `v2.0.9` stays available.
